title: Placeholder post: replace newsUrl in tools/content.json
excerpt: This local file exists only so the news pipeline can be exercised before the real site is wired up. Point newsUrl at your blog's RSS feed or a JSON endpoint and these cards fill themselves in.

title: Both JSON and RSS feeds are accepted
excerpt: A stock WordPress or Ghost feed works with no extra endpoint. If you would rather control the shape, serve a JSON array of title, url, date, excerpt, image and tag.

title: Cards open in the default browser
excerpt: Links are restricted to http and https, so a compromised feed cannot hand the shell a file path or another protocol to execute.
